newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corporate bonds higher track U.S. Treasuries.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corporate bonds higher track U.S. Treasuries.

text.p: U.S. high-grade corporate bonds traded higher in line with U.S. Treasuries in light trade with spreads seen tighter by about a basis point, dealers said.
Spreads to U.S. Treasuries tightened by a basis point across most maturities, dealers said.
"We've seen some decent buying," said one high-grade trader. "There's a generally positive tone to the market it seems like money has been put to work in the secondary market."
